title: I want that one!
author: Mala Kumar
description: "Not that one" says Anil's mother when he asks for something. "Not that one!" say all the shopkeepers in the market too. That makes the little boy very angry indeed!

title: Story of Solar Energy
author: Arvind Gupta
description:
Written by Arvind Gupta and Illustrated by Reshma Barve is a simple comic book for children. It traces the use of the Sun’s energy by human societies in a historical
          perspective. All cultures since time immemorial have deified and prayed to the sun. India is blessed with abundant sunshine. Post Fukushima the world is searching for alternatives. This
          picture, non-technical book will delight children while at the same time sensitise them in thinking about energy alternatives.

title: Be Wise with Money
author: Mala Kumar
description:
It is not enough just to earn and save money. One has to manage money wisely so that there is enough for your needs and wants now and for later. Do you know what Salim Ali did with
  his pocket money? Does everything have a price? What is the price of sunshine? What is insurance?

title: Sanu, The Frog
author: Shanta Das Manandhar, Babina Shah
description: यो कथाको किताब प्राथमिक तहका विद्यार्थी भाइबहिनीहरूका लागी भनि तयार पारिएको हो। यो कथा एक जिज्ञासु सानू भ्यागुताको हो। सानू भ्यागुता बकुल्ला उडेको  देखेपछि आफू पनि उड्न खोज्छ। ऊ आफ्नी काकीसँग उड्ने विषयमा धरै कुरा सोधिरहन्छ। कथा रमाइलो छ, कौतूहलतापूर्ण छ।

title: Chunu and Munu Read
author: Shanta Das Manandhar
description: Chunu and Munu discover the joys of reading!

title: Akbar and Birbal: Moral Stories
author: Unknown
description:
The friendship between Emperor Akbar and his minister Birbal created history—and some delightful stories! The tales of Akbar and Birbal have been passed on from generation to
          generation, enthralling young and old listeners alike. This book brings together a selection of these stories, along with fascinating historical details about the Mughal court, the emperor
          and his witty courtier.

title: The Treaty of Kathmandu
author: Kanak Mani Dixit
description: The story about how kites reached Kathmandu and why they are only flown during the harvest festival season.

title: The Red Fairy Book
author: Andrew Lang
description:
Andrew Lang's Fairy Books or Andrew Lang's "Coloured" Fairy Books constitute a twelve-book series of fairy tale collections. Although Andrew Lang did not collect the stories himself
  from the oral tradition, the extent of his sources, who had collected them originally (with the notable exception of Madame d'Aulnoy), made them an immensely influential collection, especially as
  he used foreign-language sources, giving many of these tales their first appearance in English. As acknowledged in the prefaces, although Lang himself made most of the selections, his wife and
  other translators did a large portion of the translating and telling of the actual stories. The Red Fairy Book is the second in the series. (wikipedia)

title: Akbar, Emperor of India
author: Richard von Garbe
description:
Originally published in 1909, this early work is both expensive and hard to find in its first edition. A picture of life and customs from the sixteenth century, centred around
  Jalaluddin Muhammad Akbar, the third Mughal Emperor of the Mughal dynasty in India, one of the most powerful empires of the time which covered the majority of northern and central India. It it is a
  fascinating read for any enthusiast or historian of India.

title: A Street, or a Zoo?
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description:
Sonu, Monu and Rina discovered many things together in 'Colours on the Street'. In this second book, the three friends set out to play. Little did they know what they would meet so
  many animals. Would you like to meet them too?

title: A Book for Kids
author: C. J. Dennis
description:
Forty-nine illustrated poems, rhymes and stories to capture the imagination of children in 1920s Australia. The individual stories and poems engage with the realities and fantasies
  associated with people, the birds and animals and the life of the town.

title: Our Growing Needs: A Book on our Environment and Conservation of Life contd.
author: Kabita Thapa, C. Masand
description: This is an introductory book on our environment and conservation of life, most suitable for class 5.

title: How Do Aeroplanes Fly?
author: Aditi Sarawagi
description:
Sarla wished she could fly high like an eagle or like an aeroplane. Of course you can fly, said her new teacher. Here, Sarla shares all that she has learnt about flight and
  aeroplanes.

title: Funny story
author: Khothatso Ranoosi
description: Meet some unusual animals and people in this unusual story!

title: A Very Important Tree
author: Elana Bregin
description: Busi loves the big, beautiful tree outside her house. But her brother wants to cut it down. How will she stop him?

title: A Helping Hand
author: Payal Dhar
description:
There's a new girl in class and our teacher has asked me to be her friend and show her around. But I'm not sure I want to - she's... not like the rest of us! A fascinating tale of
  friendship and fitting in, which tells its story through letters.

title: ठूलो फुल (A Big Egg)
author: Roma Pradhan
description: यो कथा आफ्नो ओथारामा पाइएको ठूलो फुलको साँच्चीकैकी आमा फेला पार्न हिँडेकी कुखुरीको कथा हो। साँच्चीकैकी आमाको खोजीका क्रममा हिँडेकी कुखुरीको थरी–थरीका जन्तुहरूसित चिनापर्ची हुन्छ। ऊ तिनीहरूसित भलाकुसारी गर्छे र तिनीहरूका आनीबानी र अन्य विषयमा अनेकन कुरा थाहा पाउँछे। यसरी कथाले बालजिज्ञासालाई बुझ्‍न तिनको पूर्ति गर्न प्रयत्‍न गरेको छ।

title: Too Much Noise
author: Noni
description:
Sringeri Srinivas, the lovable farmer with very long hair, has to take his cows along the new highway, to the cattle fair. Our farmer finds the noise just too much, but he finds a
  smart new solution! As usual!

title: The Moon and the Cap
author: Noni
description:
Do you like to wear a cap on a sunny day?
Find out who else likes to wear a cap in this charming book.  [goodreads]

title: My Ten Friends
author: Suman Raj Tamrakar
description: This is a story about things that come into daily use in our homes, which help us keep clean and healthy.

title: Meena Series: We Love Books
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many
          ways, Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she
          laughs, climbs trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. This story highlights the need for quality education.

title: Little Painters
author: Cheryl Rao
description: Painting the house is such fun! But what colour should the gate be?

title: Chunu & Munu: Our School
author: Shanta Das Manandhar
description: Two twin girls sing a poem to each other about how wonderful and exciting their school is.

title: World Famous Nursary Rhymes Volume 2
author: David Whitney
description: A large, beautifully illustrated collection of familiar English nursery rhymes, great for toddlers learning to speak.

title: Whose House is This?
author: Ananta Prasad Wagle
description: This book for early readers tells the story of a curious child who shares his house with many animals — from a cow in the shed to a bird on the roof.

title: Turtle Story
author: Kartik Shanker
description:
Under cover of darkness, baby olive ridley turtles hatch from sun-warmed eggs on remote beaches. One of them, the little hatchling who is the narrator of our story, is delighted to
  make it across the beach and into the ocean without losing her way or being captured by predators. But can our little olive ridley survive the dangers of the ocean? Will she make it past the deadly
  sharks and the terrible fishing nets and reach adulthood? Will she ever have the pleasure of laying her own brood of eggs? Find out in this charming life story of an olive ridley turtle, and meet
  several other interesting creatures along the way.

title: The Story Of Bagh Bhairav Temple
author: Rocky Maharjan
description: The children of Kirtipur spend their days looking after their sheep and making statues from clay. One day, they go to a neighboring forest to gather leaves for a big, new clay tiger statue. When the children return, their sheep are gone! Could the statue have eaten their sheep?

title: The Soil
author: Prabhat Sapkota
description: This book for early readers describes the uses and importance of soil.

title: The Power of Time
author: Asmaa Emara
description: One night Henry can't sleep because the clock's second hand is making a loud noise. What happens when Henry tries to remove the second hand from the clock?

title: The Happy Prince and Other Tales
author: Oscar Wilde
keywords: The Happy Prince and Other Tales
description:
The Happy Prince and Other Tales (sometimes called The Happy Prince and Other Stories) is a collection of stories for children by Oscar Wilde first published in May 1888. It
          contains five stories, "The Happy Prince", "The Nightingale and the Rose", "The Selfish Giant", "The Devoted Friend", and "The Remarkable Rocket". It is most famous for its title story,
          "The Happy Prince".

title: The Dance of the Flamingo
author: Anita Mani
description:
Living like lotus flowers on water, the sight of pink flamingos in one of the most beautiful sights of the natural worlds. Why are they pink? Do they put on make-up? Do they have
  even a single bone in their long neck? Here is a book of photographs that answers all the questions about these graceful birds.

title: Stories for Parents, Children and Grandchildren - Volume 1
author: Paulo Coelho
description:
This book by Paulo Coelho contains joyful, amazing and dramatic stories for readers of all ages. Most of them recount traditional legends and tales from many cultures. Included are
  also stories inspired by the author’s personal experience and episodes from the lives of celebrated names, as means of reflection.

title: So Many Guests
author: Kanchan Bannerjee
description: One guest…Two guests…Six guests…What is special today in Ovi’s home?

title: Our Growing Needs: A Book on our Environment and Conservation of Life
author: Kabita Thapa, C. Masand
description: This is an introductory book on our environment and conservation of life, most suitable for class 5.

title: My Own Life is Happy
author: Shashwat Parajuli
description: My Own Life is Happy is one Nepali Folktale published by Room to Read as part of a collection called Sinhapata Maiju and Other Tales.

title: Japanese Fairy Tales
author: Yei Theodora Ozaki
description:
This collection of Japanese fairy tales is the outcome of a suggestion made to me indirectly through a friend by Mr. Andrew Lang. They have been translated from the modern
          version written by Sadanami Sanjin. These stories are not literal translations, and though the Japanese story and all quaint Japanese expressions have been faithfully preserved, they have
          been told more with the view to interest young readers of the West than the technical student of folk-lore.

title: How Money Travels !
author: Mala Kumar
description: Money travels from one person to another, one place to another. Is it stored in a cave under a big bank? What is an ATM? Why do people pay tax?

title: Fat King Thin Dog
author: Parismita
description: Run along with the Fat King after the Thin Dog!

title: Big bang and turtles
author: Anastasia Gosteva
description: This publication was prepared by the Charity Foundation Institute of Tolerance (Russia) with the help of the UNESCO Moscow Office.

title: Amazing Daisy!
author: Nozizwe Herero
description: On a little farm lives Daisy, a little chicken who wishes she could fly. All the other chickens laugh at her daily flying practice. But one day something amazing happens

title: Adventures of a Nepali Frog
author: Kanak Mani Dixit
description:
An young frog from Kathmandu Valley named Bhaktaprasad Bhyaguto decides to travel his country. He rides a tin can downriver, treks past majestic mountain peaks and hops across a good
  part of Nepal before returning to Kathmandu.

title: A Tiny Seed: The Story of Wangari Maathai
author: Nicola Rijsdijk
description: In a village on the slopes of Mount Kenya, a little girl worked in the fields with her mother. She worried as she saw the big forests disappearing, but she knew the power of a tiny seed.

title: A Perfect Match
author: Ramendra Kumar
description:
When the Halwas and the Jalebis were playing against each other, it was more than just a hockey match. It was a game full of delectable thrills where talent, team work and team
  management were on full display. Add a dash of the unexpected and you have what can only be called a perfect match!

title: बाल सन्दर्भ सामाग्री : बालवोध - ४६ मेरो सानो भाई (बाल कविता)
author: प्रभा भट्टराई

title: Young or Old?
author: Mukesh Malviya
description: A little boy is old enough to tie his shoes, but too young to help his father paint the house. He is old enough to feed himself, but too young to help his mother cook. Is he too young, or too old?

title: World Famous Nursery Rhymes Volume 1
author: David Whitney
description: A large, beautifully illustrated collection of familiar English nursery rhymes, great for toddlers learning to speak.

title: What is Love?
author: Agnes de Bezenac, Salem de Bezenac
description: Love is demonstrated in many different ways for different people.

title: We Love Celebrations!
author: Dhyanvi Katharani
description: The children see many changes that took place in their village. They decide it is time to celebrate all these new changes. How will they celebrate? Who will participate in this celebration?

title: Uncle Owl
author: Binoy Barman
description: Rats are everywhere in the village! They are destroying rice paddies, wheat fields and chewing clothes and books to bits. The villagers request Uncle Owl to help them scare off the devilish rats.

title: Toothless Charu
author: Krishna Deep Sigdel
description: This is the story of a little girl named Charu who is scared of pulling her loose tooth out. Read the story to find out how Charu becomes toothless.

title: Tommy Tempo in England
author: Christine Stone
description: बालबालिकाको पठन सिप बढाउन, मनोरञ्जन प्रदान गर्न, मानसिक र बौद्धिक विकासका लागि सिकाइ सम्बद्ध सन्दर्भ सामग्रीहरूको महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका हुन्छ। सन्दर्भ सामग्रीले बालबालिकालाई अध्ययनशील बनाउनका साथै पढाइ सिप विकास गरी पाठ्य पुस्तकमा भएका विषय वस्तु ग्रहण गर्नसमेत मदत गर्छ।

title: Think Before You Act
author: Shiva Hari Adhikari
description: A man takes advice from his friend without thinking twice about it himself. Where do you think this will lead him?

title: The Ugly Duckling
author: Hans Christian Andersen
description:
A classic story by Hans Christian Andersen presented with modern illustrations. The story of how a little bird endures the abuses and miseries as he was growing up not
          realizing he would mature into a beautiful swan. It’s a great tale about personal transformation for the better.

title: The Tale of Mr. Tod
author: Beatrix Potter
description:
The tale begins with Tommy Brock, a badger, being entertained by old Mr. Bouncer, the father of Benjamin Bunny. Mr. Bouncer has been left to tend his grandchildren while his son and
  daughter-in-law Flopsy are away, but, after smoking a pipe of rabbit-tobacco, he falls asleep in Tommy's company.

title: The Sparrow and the Fruit
author: Venkatramana Gowda
description:
When her plump juicy guava falls into a clump of thorns, Gubbi uses every trick she knows, and gets the fruit back. But is it right to use mead tricks to get what you want? Find out
  by reading this book!

title: The Money Managers
author: Mala Kumar
description:
Meet Team Kuber, Team Dhanadhan and Team Chanakya in this book. They help you save money; they lend you money when you need it and they help you increase your wealth. How do people
  with very little money start a business?

title: The Ladybird
author: Shanta Das Manandhar
description: Two children discover a ladybird while walking back from school. What kind of insect is it?

title: The Golden Fleece and the Heroes Who Lived Before Achilles
author: Padraic Colum
keywords: The Golden Fleece and the Heroes
description:
The Golden Fleece and the Heroes Who Lived Before Achilles is a children's book by Padraic Colum, a retelling of Greek myths. The book, illustrated by Willy Pogany, was first
  published in 1921 and was a Newbery Honor recipient in 1922. The central myth retold is that of Jason and the Argonauts in their quest for the Golden Fleece and the aftermath. Woven into it are
  other myths, including the myths of Persephone and Prometheus, told by the poet Orpheus during the voyage.

title: The Fables of Aesop
author: Joseph Jacobs
description:
Rich selection of time-honored tales by legendary Greek storyteller offers youngsters valuable lessons and insights into life. Includes "The Fox and the Grapes," "The Old Man and
  Death," "The Wolf in Sheep's Clothing," "The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse," and dozens more.

title: The Dog's Eggs
author: Chandan Yadav
description: A mama bird lays four eggs. One day, when she leaves the nest to search for food, she comes back to find that someone has taken her place!

title: The Day The Vegetables Came To School
author: Venkatramana Gowda
description:
Raju cannot believe his eyes. On his way to school, he sees vegetables of all shapes and sizes also headed there, carrying their schoolbags and water bottles! What's more, no one
  else, including his teacher, seems surprised to see them. Whatever is going on?

title: The Crescent Moon
author: Rabindranath Tagore
description: Child Poems

title: Sworn to Secrecy (Nature stories for young readers)
author: Vidya and Rajaram Sharma
description: Some quick thinking and persistent efforts help a child unravel the secrets of a few birds.

title: Sani, the Beautiful Little Girl
author: Dhruva Ghimire
description: Little Sani wants to go out and she has to look beautiful. She decides to put on her mother's makeup. Will she look beautiful in the end? Read on to find out.

title: Sani and Suri
author: Shilpi Pradhan
description: Sani has a pet cat called Suri. One day, she comes back from school, but cannot find Suri anywhere. While searching all over, she meets different kinds of cats, but none of them are Suri. Will she find her pet? Read and find out!

title: Prophet Ibrahim
author: Kamal al-Syyed - XKP
description: The Destroyer of Idols - The Story of Our Prophet Ibrahim By: Kamal al-Syyed Translated by: Jasim al-Rasheed islamicmobility.com

title: Peacocks and Pakodas!
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description:
From listening to a melodious Kajari to watching tiny waterfalls and from the lovely scent of moist soil to the smell of Amma's pakodas, Meenu loves every bit of the
  monsoon.

title: One day in August
author: Bharati Jagannathan
description:
Kishen's cow strays away one day in August, leading him and his friend Shagufta into unknown territory. This gentle story of love, friendship, and the innocent wisdom of childhood is
  set against a time when the partition of India caused immense loss to millions of people.

title: Nima's First Day of School
author: Krishna Deep Sigdel
description: It's her first day of school. Nima gets new shoes, a new bag, and a new pen, but she still does not feel happy. What could help Nima feel happy again?

title: My Teacher
author: Zimbili Dlamini, Hlengiwe Zondi
description: How much do you love your teacher?

title: My Juggling Granny
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description: Meet a bright and playful grandmother. She loves to juggle!

title: My Hero is You
author: Unknown
description:
“My Hero is You” is a book written for children around the world affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.

“My Hero is You” should be read by a parent, caregiver or teacher alongside a child or a small group of children. It is not encouraged for children to read this book independently without the support of a parent, caregiver or teacher. The supple-mentary guide called “Actions for Heroes” (to be published later) offers support for addressing topics related to COVID-19, helping children manage feelings and emotions, as well as supplementary activities for children to do based on the book.

title: My Car
author: Phidi Pulu
description: Khaidi has a very special car that takes him to many places. Drooomm... he drives wherever he wants to go. Come, join him on a drive around the world.

title: Money Math -With Funky Fairy
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description: How does math move money? Funky Fairy helps: add  bills; take-away change; multiply wages and divide a pie.

title: Meena Series: Reaching Out
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many
          ways, Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she
          laughs, climbs trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. This story deals with community care and support for people living with HIV
          and AIDS .

title: Meena Series: Let's Go to School Together
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many ways,
  Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she laughs, climbs
  trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do.

title: Meaning of Money - The American Way
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
Throughout time, Leaders have put their own pictures on money to show their power. Americans are different. They put symbols of Independence, Liberty and Freedom on
  money.

title: Kanchha, the Rhino
author: Shilpi Pradhan
description: This is the story of a little rhino who lives in a big grassland. He loves to explore, but one day he strays too far from his mother and gets lost. Read on to find out how he gets out of trouble.

title: I Love My Planet
author: Peter Reichenbach
description: Loving the planet also means taking care of it. Read to find out how these children do their bit to take care of the planet they love.

title: Everything you need to know about life taught by a 3 year old
author: Peter Barbas
description:
All the answers to life most important questions and challenges as addressed by a 3 year old. If you thought children could not teach you anything, think again. Some of lifes
          most valuable lessons are in this book and you can benefit from them whether you are 3 or 93. Very funny and relevant to everyday life.

title: Cuckoo Wants To Sing
author: Meheruba Nisha
description: Cuckoo has lost his song. He tries to find his voice throughout the seasons, as flowers bloom and rains come. Will he ever sing again?

title: Cracking the Code: Women Who Have Changed the Way We Look at Computers
author: Alisha Sadikot
description: What do 19th Century English mathematician Ada Lovelace, new-age fashion designer Anouk Wipprecht, and the current Digital Minister of Taiwan Audrey Tang have in common? They’ve all impacted the way we look at computers and coding. This book introduces some inspiring women from the world of technology, from across a century.

title: Computer Come-Froms: From Roots to Real-Time
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
Where did computers come-from? How did the roots of IC's and Apples, sprinkled with flower-power lead to personal computers? This is the true story behind our real-time, worldwide
  computer connections.

title: Civil Sense
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
The American Civil War resulted in over a million casualties. Every person who died and all property destroyed was done by fellow countrymen. “Civil Sense” asks the question, What if
  there wasn’t a Civil War? What if we find ways to resolve differences other than by fighting each other?

title: Chunu & Munu: Let's Sing and Dance for Nature!
author: Shanta Das Manandhar, Shilpi Pradhan
description: Chunu and Munu look around them. Everything in nature is singing and dancing. They also want to sing and dance!

title: Bounthy's Singing Birds
author: Sinthanou Sidavone
description: Bounthy’s father captures birds and puts them in cages. Bounthy likes listening to the birds singing, but one day the birds stop singing. Will Bounthy be able to make the birds sing again?

title: Animal Homes
author: Ashwitha Jayakumar
description: Tall homes, tree homes, hanging homes, underground homes—visit different homes of animals, birds and insects all around you.

title: American Fairy Tales
author: L. Frank Baum
description: Young cowboy lassoes Father Time; dummy in Mr. Floman's department store window comes to life; and 10 other fairy tales.

title: Adventures of Tom Thumb
author: Logan Marshall
description: The story of Tom Thumb is well-known: a poor, childless farmer and his wife feed a raggedy beggar, and he rewards them with a son the size of the husband's thumb. The farmer and his wife name their son Tom Thumb, and try to protect him from the perils of the world.

title: A Sweet Apple
author: Kedar Shrestha
description: Rajani loves to draw using her imagination. However, her mother always wonders why Rajani’s drawings aren’t more realistic. How can Rajani show her mother that there’s not just one right way to draw?

title: A Special Nest
author: Kavita Singh
description: A bird is trying to build a nest for herself. But everywhere she builds a nest, something or the other disturbs her. What will she do?

title: A Rainbow Tangled up
author: Marina Kavallieraki
description:
Urania, the rainbow fairy, was feeling very tired. A sudden rain shower down to Mani, then another up in Xanthi and she was running to unfold the rainbow ribbons from side to side.
  But apart from the distance that she had to cover, she had at the same time to cope with the caprices of every ribbon! However, she saw a gold gentle cloud and she decided to rest. What will happen
  to the ribbons now? What kind of adventure will they take part in?

title: A Pair of Schoolgirls
author: Angela Brazil
description: "A Pair of Schoolgirls" is a 1912 fictional story by English author Angela Brazil. It follows the story of Dorothy and the trails she faces being a young girl at an all-girls day school in England.

title: A House of Pomegranates
author: Oscar Wilde
description:
A House of Pomegranates is a collection of fairy tales, written by Oscar Wilde, that was published as a second collection for The Happy Prince and Other Tales
          (1892).

title: बाल सन्दर्भ सामाग्री : बालवोध - ३९ वल भन्दा बुद्धि ठुलो (कथा सँगालो)
author: विश्वम्भर चञ्चल

title: Zenande's Helping Hands
author: Wendy Shelembe
description: During heavy rains, a little kindness can go a long way. Join Zenande as she comes together with her community.

title: World Famous Nursery Rhymes Volume 3
author: David Whitney
description: A compilation of beautifully illustrated traditional nursery rhymes, the third in the series.

title: Why oh Why
author: Richa Bhaskar
description: Here is a book that will make little readers make faces at each other!

title: Who is Faster?
author: Shilpi Pradhan
description: Which animal is fast and which is slow? This book tells young readers which animals are faster than others.

title: Where is my Brother's Blankie?
author: Lita Lestianti
description: Bayu's baby brother is getting cranky. He wants his favorite batik blankie. Will Bayu be able to find it?

title: When Will the Power Come Back?
author: Dhyanvi Katharani
keywords: When Will the Power Come Back?
description: The children are not able to study because of the constant powercuts. They encourage Salim Bhai, the village electrician to do something about it. Salim Bhai has an idea. Will this idea solve their problem?

title: What's That Sound?
author: Deepti Tiwari
description: It’s late at night and Reena is lying in bed. Suddenly, she starts to hear a strange noise coming from somewhere in the house…

title: What Have You Found?
author: Unknown
description: The animals are hungry. What will they eat?

title: We call her Ba
author: Subhadra Sen Gupta
description:
Kasturb Gandhi was no ordinary women. She had a strong identity, courage and tremendous willpower and she sacrificed a lot for her country. She was a friend and trusted companion of
  the Father of the Nation, Mahatma Gandhi. Gandhiji's biographer, Louis Fischer wrote about her, "Being herself and being at the same time a shadow of the Mahatma made her a remarkable women." Read
  about this amazing woman who walked shoulder to shoulder with one of the most prominent leaders of the world during the most turbulent times of this peninsula.

title: Water and Soil
author: Sofia Politou-Ververi
description:
Why do we always have to fight without using our brains? Is that the human nature after all? And those knights? Thank goodness, they and their kings came to their senses at the last
  moment! Life is joy and celebration, we have nothing to share with each other except for a nice meal, a dance, a song and a hug! This is the real world and it makes some people feel really
  uncomfortable! In the end, what did the two kings accomplish? Which path did they choose?

title: Walking Together
author: Jade Mathieson
description: A walk to the clinic doesn’t have to be dull, when there are so many wonderful things to see on the way.

title: Up World, Down World
author: Padmaparna Ghosh
description:
In a canopy forest in India, the Up World and Down World have always been suspicious of each other. But it all changes when Gopa the dormouse drops her book by accident of Fatima's
  head. A story about friendship and the biodiversity of canopy forest.

title: Uncle Wiggily and Mother Goose Part II
author: Howard R. Garis
description: Beginning in 1910, Howard Roger Garis penned an Uncle Wiggily tale every day (except Sundays) for 30 years, much to the delight of both children and adult fans of the elderly gentleman rabbit. Join Uncle Wiggily in outwitting such outrageous creatures as the Pipsiseweh, Skeeziks, Bazumpus, Crozokus and the Scuttlemagoon while teaching heartwarming life lessons.

title: Two Mice
author: Aruna Keerthi Gamage
description: One day, a real mouse met a computer mouse. Suddenly, a cat began to chase the real mouse and tried to catch him. What happened next?

title: Topsy Turvy
author: Noni
description: Everything is turning upside down in a little boy's house ...... what could be the reason for this?

title: Tommy Tempo in the Tempo Race
author: Christine Stone

title: There's a Hole in my Galaxy
author: Ananya Dasgupta
description: Three friends blast off from Earth in a rocket to explore the Solar System. Suddenly, they find themselves being pulled by a black hole. Do they manage to escape? Find out what happens on this space odyssey.

title: The story of Little Black Sambo
author: Helen Bannerman
description:
The jolly and exciting tale of the little boy who lost his red coat and his blue trousers and his purple shoes but who was saved from the tigers to eat 169 pancakes for his supper,
  has been universally loved by generations of children. First written in 1899, the story has become a childhood classic and the authorized American edition with the original drawings by the author
  has sold hundreds of thousands of copies. Little Black Sambo is a book that speaks the common language of all nations, and has added more to the joy of little children than perhaps any other story.
  They love to hear it again and again; to read it to themselves; to act it out in their play.

title: The Yellow Fairy Book
author: Andrew Lang
description:
The Editor thinks that children will readily forgive him for publishing another Fairy Book. We have had the Blue, the Red, the Green, and here is the Yellow. If children are pleased,
  and they are so kind as to say that they are pleased, the Editor does not care very much for what other people may say.

title: The Yearling
author: Marjorie Kinnan Rawlings
description:
A child named Jody Baxter lives with his parents, Ora and Ezra "Penny" Baxter, in the animal-filled central Florida backwoods at the start of the twentieth century. His
          parents had six other children prior to Jody, but they died in infancy. He loves the outdoors and loves his family. He has wanted a pet for as long as he can remember, yet his mother Ora
          says they only have enough food to feed themselves.

title: The World of Money !
author: Mala Kumar
description: What were early coins made of? How do people earn, save and use money? Can the family buy a fridge even if it does not have the money for it today?

title: The Wisdom of Father Brown
author: Gilbert Keith Chesterton
description:
Father Brown is a fictional character created by English novelist G. K. Chesterton, who stars in 52 short stories, later compiled in five books. Chesterton based the character on
  Father John O’Connor (1870–1952), a parish priest in Bradford who was involved in Chesterton’s conversion to Catholicism in 1922. The relationship was recorded by O’Connor in his 1937 book Father
  Brown on Chesterton.

title: The Will
author: Anis Azmi
description:
How can half of seventeen camels be given to someone? Here is a story that illustrates the wisdom of a father, Abdullah bin Saad, and the intelligence of a mother, Rukaiya Khatoon,
  who solves the puzzle and ensures harmony between her sons.

title: The Violet Fairy Book
author: Andrew Lang
description: This is a new collection of Fairy stories in continuation of the series which "The Blue Fairy Book" was the initial volume.

title: The Tricky Mickey
author: Ganga Paudel
description: Children's Story Collection

title: The Tree
author: Usha Rane
description: Big ideas in fun stories for children to read and enjoy.

title: The Tin Woodman of Oz
author: Lyman Frank Baum
description:
Join the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow as they journey across the fantastic magical Land of Oz in search of the Tin Woodman's long-lost sweetheart. In a series of adventures
          sure to thrill Oz fans both old and new, these beloved friends face such challenges as a selfish giantess and a group of quarrelsome dragons--all to fulfill a promise made long ago to a
          beautiful Munchkin girl. The Tin Woodman sits on the glittering tin throne of his splendid tin castle, ruling the Winkle Country of the Land of Oz with the help of his best friend, the
          Scarecrow. All is peaceful and well, but when a young wanderer named Woot asks the Tin Woodman how he came to be made of tin, the emperor recalls his days as a flesh-and-blood wood-chopper
          and his love for Nimmie Amee, a Munchkin girl so fair that the sunsets blushed when they fell upon her.

title: The Tale of Samuel Whiskers or The Roly-Poly Pudding
author: Beatrix Potter
description:
The theme of the tale is the childhood sin of disobedience. Tom Kitten is a young cat who lives with his mother, Mrs. Tabitha Twitchit, and sisters, Moppet and Mittens, in a house
  overrun with rats.

title: The Tale of Flopsy Bunnies
author: Beatrix Potter
description:
Benjamin Bunny and Peter Rabbit are adults, and Benjamin has married his cousin Flopsy. The couple are the parents of six children generally called The Flopsy Bunnies.
          Benjamin and Flopsy are "very improvident and cheerful" and have some difficulty feeding their many children.

title: The Tale of Benjamin Bunny
author: Beatrix Potter
description:
When Mr. McGregor and his wife leave home in their gig, Benjamin Bunny and his cousin Peter Rabbit venture into Mr. McGregor's garden to retrieve the clothes Peter lost there in The
  Tale of Peter Rabbit.

title: The Surprising Adventures of Puss in Boots
author: OLE Nepal
keywords: The Surprising Adventures of Puss in Boots
description:
A classic fairy tale involving a poor millers son and his wise cat named Puss-in-Boots who engineers an amazing adventure from rags to riches. Learn how Puss-in-Boots got his
          name, beat an evil wizard and helped his master become the Marquis of Caraba.

title: The Story of the Three Little Pigs
author: L. Leslie Brooke
keywords: The Story of the Three Little Pigs
description:
The first that went off met a Man with a bundle of straw, and said to him, "Please, Man, give me that straw to build me a house"; which the Man did, and the little Pig built a house
  with it. Presently came along a Wolf, and knocked at the door, and said, "Little Pig, little Pig, let me come in." To which the Pig answered, "No, no, by the hair of my chinny chin chin." "Then
  I'll huff and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!" said the Wolf. So he huffed and he puffed, and he blew his house in, and ate up the little Pig.

title: The Story About Ping
author: Marjorie Flack Kurt Wiese
description:
A beautiful story of a beautiful duck called Ping who lives with his mother and his father and two sisters and three brothers and eleven aunts and seven uncles and forty-two cousins.
  Contributed by: Arvind Gupta

title: The Princess and Curdie
author: George Macdonald
description:
A sequel to The Princess and the Goblin: Princess Irene and Curdie are a year or two older, and must overthrow a set of corrupt ministers who are poisoning Irene's father,
          the king.

title: The Prince And The Pauper
author: Mark Twain
description:
The book represents Twain's first attempt at historical fiction. Set in 1547, the novel tells the story of two young boys who are identical in appearance: Tom Canty, a pauper who
  lives with his abusive father in Offal Court off Pudding Lane in London, and Edward VI of England, son of Henry VIII of England. - wikipedia.org

title: The Picnic
author: Amar Goswami
description: When five friends go for a picnic they not only have a great time, they also eat new and exciting food!

title: The Motor Rangers' Cloud Cruiser
author: Marvin West
description:
From the “Nomad” to the “Discoverer,” from the sea to the sky, the scene changes in which the Motor Rangers figure. They have experiences “that never were on land or sea,” in
          heat and cold and storm, over mountain peak and lost city, with savages and reptiles; their ship of the air is attacked by huge birds of the air; they survive explosion and earthquake; they
          even live to tell the tale!

title: The Master of the World
author: Jules Verne
description: Evil master criminal sets out for world domination from the French pioneer of Science Fiction.

title: The Market Dentist
author: Unknown
description:
This story has been produced for UNESCO as part of its commitment to the FRESH initiative (Focussing Resources on Effective School Health). The story deal with issues such as
  hygiene, sanitation, disease prevention, violence, discrimination and disaster preparedness. Story telling and story writing can not only confirm knowledge and raise interest but also develop a
  whole range of language and life skills and enhance vital attitudes which children need to develop at school.

title: The Magic City
author: E. Nesbit
description: An extremely unhappy ten-year-old magically escapes into a city he has built out of books, chessmen, candlesticks, and other household items.

title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine De Saint-Exupery
description:
Written by Antoine de Saint-Exupery, who was a French author, journalist and pilot in 1943, one year before his death, the Little Prince appears to be a simple children’s tale. This
  profound tale, written in riddles and laced with philosophy and poetic metaphor, is a story of a young boy who goes travelling around the universe. During his travel he has extraordinary encounters
  which reveal to him the follies of adult behaviour. It's a moving book and takes the reader through a process of reflection on the adult world through the eyes of a child. Contributed by: Arvind
  Gupta

title: The Little People of the Snow
author: William Cullen Bryant
keywords: The Little People of the Snow
description:
Unlike some other reproductions of classic texts (1) We have not used OCR(Optical Character Recognition), as this leads to bad quality books with introduced typos. (2) In books where
  there are images such as portraits, maps, sketches etc We have endeavoured to keep the quality of these images, so they represent accurately the original artefact. Although occasionally there may
  be certain imperfections with these old texts, we feel they deserve to be made available for future generations to enjoy.

title: The Lion and the Rabbit
author: Unknown
description: How does the rabbit trick the lion and keep himself alive?

title: The Lal Badam Tree
author: Rumana Husain
description:
Rashida and Anwar could not understand why their mother forbade them from eating the lal badams that they loved! Didn't she realize how much fun it was to eat them straight from the
  tree? Feast on this sweet story from Pakistan written originally in Urdu.

title: The Hat Seller
author: Ananta Prasad Wagle
description: On a long day's work, a hat seller rests under a tree without realizing that a family of monkeys are living in its branches. Curious as ever, the monkeys come down from the branches and take all of the hats from the hat seller’s bag. Join the hat seller as he tries to trick the monkeys into giving him his hats back.

title: The Hare and the Tortoise (Again!)
author: Venkatramana Gowda
description:
Remember how the slow and steady tortoise beat the arrogant hare in that great race long ago? Now the two are back together again, and they have a task to complete. Each knows that
  he cannot do it without the other, but can these two big rivals work together?

title: The Happy Prince and Other Tales
author: Oscar Wilde
keywords: The Happy Prince and Other Tales
description: A pleasure seeking prince, a selfish giant, and more: Wilde's fairy tales, first published in 1888, for childlike people from eighteen to eighty."

title: The Hand Book
author: David Whitney
description: A rhyming book all about hands, great fun and nice bright illustrations.

title: The Grey Fairy Book
author: Andrew Lang
description: The tales in the Grey Fairy Book are derived from many countries—Lithuania, various parts of Africa, Germany, France, Greece, and other regions of the world.

title: The Green Bean festival
author: Unknown
description: One day, while playing in the green bean fields at her grandmother’s house, Nam meets a new friend – a green bean seed. He invites her to meet his family and to join their festival. What new discoveries will she make on her adventure?

title: The Ghost of the Mountains
author: Sujatha Padmanabhan
description:
The residents of Ang, a small village in the Himalayan mountains in Ladakh, wake up one morning to find an unusual visitor in their midst. The villagers are angry, very
          angry, and threaten to kill the visitor. A young lad of the village is the only one who feels that the visitor must be spared. What can he possibly do?

title: The Flying Train
author: Janaki Sooriyarachchi
description: One night, a flying train takes Jimmy and Nelly on an adventure to outer space. Was it all just a dream?

title: The Fascinating Fibonaccis
author: Shonali Chinniah
description:
Almost a thousand years ago, an Indian scholar called Hemachandra discovered a fascinating number sequence. A cuntury later, the same sequence caught the attention of Italian
  mathmetician Fibonacci, who wrote about it. The Fibonacci sequence is fascinating as it is repeated many, many times in nature - in flowers, seashells, eggs, stars... Find out more inside this
  book!

title: The Fairytale of Red Riding Hood
author: Charles Perrault
keywords: The Fairytale of Red Riding Hood
description:
A classic fairy tale of good and evil, this story follows Little Red Riding Hood into the forest and along the wooded path to deliver a basket of food to her sick grandmother. But
  she encounters a Big Bad Wolf with an empty stomach and a cunning mind, who has other plans for Little Red Riding Hood and her grandmother. Beautifully illustrated, this classic tale will capture
  children's interest and spark their imagination encouraging a love of reading.

title: The Enchanted Castle
author: E. Nesbit
description:
Jerry, Jimmy, and Cathy stumble upon a mysterious castle with a beautiful princess asleep in the garden. The princess is really Mabel, the housekeeper's niece, who is only
          pretending to be royalty. But when she shows them a secret room filled with treasure where they discover a magical ring, enchantment becomes a reality.

title: The Dream
author: H.G. Wells
description: The book deals with the thoughts and psychological transformations of Doctor Fridolin over a two-day period after his wife confesses having had sexual fantasies involving another man. In this short time, he meets many people who give clues to the world Schnitzler creates.

title: The Crown
author: Shanta Das Manandhar
description: A young boy sees that many beautiful birds have a crown. What will he do to get his own?

title: The Centaur
author: May Swenson
description:
First published in 1955, May Swenson's "The Centaur" remains one of her most popular and most anthologized poems. This is its first appearance as a picture book for children.
          In images bright and brisk and nearly tangible, the poet re-creates the joy of riding a stick horse through a small-town summer. We find ourselves, with her, straddling "a long limber horse
          with . . . a few leaves for a tail," and pounding through the lovely dust along the path by the old canal. As her shape shifts from child to horse and back, we know exactly what she feels.
          Sherry Meidell's water-color illustrations perfectly convey the wit and wisdom of May Swenson's poem. These are playful, satisfying images full of vitality and imagination. Meidell handles
          the joy of poem's fantasy and the joy of its occasional naughtiness with equal success.

title: The Calf Calls
author: Mitralal Pangyani
description: A little calf is hungry and is waiting for her mother, the cow, to feed her. But someone has to come to unleash the cow first! How long will the calf wait for her breakfast?

title: The Blob, the Frog, the DOG and the girl
author: Nick Creech
description:
A long lonely summer looms for a new girl on an island with her busy mother. Enter two boys and their huge dog, a rival group of bullies, and a viking ship, and things look
          up. Three children learn about friendship, courage, and working together to achieve their dreams. This book is for older children, some sensitive material.

title: The Birthday Present
author: Vinaya Kasajoo
description: ‘जन्मदिनको उपहार’ माया नाउँकी कछुवा नानीको हो। उनी विद्‌यालयमा सधैजसो अबेर पुग्छिन्‌। त्यसैले समयमै पुग्न एउटा साइकल पाए हुन्थ्यो भनी उनी चिताउँछिन्‌। यो कुरा आफ्ना गुरुमा र साथीहरूलाई सुनाउँछिन्‌ र कतै पाइन्छ कि भनेर पनि सोध्छिन्‌। उनकी आमाले किनिदिन्छु त भनेकी थिइन्‌ तर कछुवाले चढ्‌ने साइकल कहाँ किन्न पाइन्छ, त्यो भने उनीलाई थाहा थिएन। उनको जन्मदिनमा उनले आफ्ना गुरुमा र साथीहरूबाट एउटा उपहार पाउँछिन्‌, तर त्यो साइकल भने होइन। साँच्चै त्यो के हो त, पढेर हेरौ र रमाऔ।

title: The Birthday Party
author: Oliver Optic
description: Flora Lee's birthday came in July. Her mother wished very much to celebrate the occasion in a proper manner. Flora was a good girl, and her parents were always glad to do any thing they could to please her, and to increase her happiness.

title: The Auto That Flew
author: Ken Spillman
description: Caught in the mad traffic of Delhi, an auto feels a touch of magic. Take a ride with the driver and the passenger and feel the feather touch of a little stardust.

title: The Animals Meeting
author: Gyananistha Gyawali
description: Animal's Meeting is a story about the relationship between animals, humans and the environment. As spring arrives, the animals and the peasants attend meetings to discuss all the things they do for the environment. Humans are also invited to the meeting. What will they talk about? Read and find out.

title: The Adventures of Philautus Frog
author: Kartik Shanker
description:
Philautus, the little tree frog wants to see the wide blue sea, so far away from his home on Big Tree, in the middle of a forest. Take a magnificent trek with Philautus across the
  Western Ghats teeming with creatures that are funny, fat and fascinating. Seasoned with humour, this lush book reveals the splendours of the wild through a compelling tale.

title: The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
author: Mark Twain
description:
The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn is an adaptation of the timeless novel by Mark Twain. Part of the Ladder Series, this volume has approximately 2000 headwords and is appropriate
  for intermediate to advanced learners. This tale of Huckleberry Finn and his adventures on the Mississippi River is a well-loved piece of American literature. Considered a classic, this book’s
  story is one of friendship, loyalty, and difficult choices.

title: That Worked!
author: Agnes de Bezenac, Salem
description:
“Sister always wants the same things that I have. How can I work this out?” A short story told from a child’s perspective, that encourages kids to think about working out this
  problem in a positive way.

title: Thai Culture on Coins
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
How can looking at coins help us better understand Thai culture? This book has easy answers. Also inside are: the Emerald Buddha, Golden Mountain, Marble and Dawn Temples and White
  Elephants.

title: Tall and Short
author: Huy Chheng Rattana
description: Can you tell which family members are tall and which are short? This book demonstrates the concept of opposites— tall and short— through the members of a child’s family.

title: Takloo - The Little Salt Seller
author: Radhika Bapat
description:
This is a story about little Takloo who stays near the salty sea with his loving family. Written by a clinical psychologist, this book can be used to teach many concepts. It also
  encourages young readers to make up their own stories.

title: Sports Day
author: Menaka Raman
description: Lace up your shoes, drink some water, and get ready for Sports Day. Happy, sad, nervous, excited - the students of KV School are feeling so many emotions. Aska-lakadi-gala-galoo, cheer them, won’t you?

title: Sindi and the Moon
author: Zanele Buthelezi, Thokozani Mkhize
description: Sindi buzzes with colourful songs and dance. Will starting school end all that?

title: Show and Tell
author: Jo Vosailagi
description: Tema is excited about Show and Tell at school. But what is she going to talk about?

title: Scaredy-Cat Moli
author: Susie Elliott
description: Moli wants to prove to her brother that she is not a scaredy-cat. Her chance comes in a most unexpected way one day at the beach.

title: Required Poems for Reading and Memorizing
author: Unknown
keywords: Required Poems for Reading and Memorizing

title: Rama Goes to Town
author: Shilpi Pradhan
description: ‘Rama Goes to Town’ tells the story of a young girl who leaves her village for the first time on a visit to the town with her father. She learns about all the different forms of transportation and motor vehicles.

title: Raju's First Flight
author: Nandita Jayaraj
description: It’s an exciting day for Raju. Join him as he prepares for a very special flight journey.

title: Puss in Boots
author: Charles Perrault
description:
Charles Perrault's Puss in Boots has been an irresistible magnet for countless illustrators ever since this classic French tale was first published in 1697. So the question arises:
  Do we really need another edition of Puss? Presented with Fred Marcellino's magnificent interpretation of this nimble new translation of the authentic text, book lovers young and old are apt to
  decide that this Puss in Boots belongs on their shelf of special favorites.

title: Picture This – Questions Quiz
author: Unknown
keywords: Activate Games for Learning American English
description:
In Question Quiz, students practice creating questions that contain very specific information about one item from a Picture This card, so that there is only one correct answer to the
  question. This game works best in groups of 2-4 students.

title: Picture This
author: Unknown
keywords: Activate Games for Learning American English
description:
Picture This cards are a set of cards that can be used for a variety of conversation and word games in English classes. These cards form the foundation for conversational games that
  give students the op­portunity to practice speaking with each other about a variety of topics. Picture This cards stimulate conversation through a series of thematically related questions and
  interesting images that engage students, activate background knowledge, and help match vocabulary words with concrete objects.

title: Our Holidays
author: Tara Pun
description: How do you spend your holidays? Join the characters in this book as they describe the things they do during their holidays.

title: Our Friends in the Wild
author: Ananta Prasad Wagle
description: Throughout time, people have shared a strong relationship with animals in nature. This non-fiction poem explores the many ways that animals help humans.

title: One Summer Afternoon
author: Mahipal
description: Children in the village grow up in close proximity with other living beings. Read this touching story of how they learn some important life lessons.

title: Naani's Terrace
author: Sukhada Rahalkar
description: Every holiday we go to our Naani’s house. Why? Our house in Mumbai has neither a terrace nor our Naani.

title: My Tree-Friend
author: Shreekumar Varma
description: We all know trees are our friends. But can friends be trees too? Just like the fruits in Ammoomma’s trees, friends can be sweet, sour, or both!

title: My Garden
author: Renuka Thapa
description: Join a young girl as she spends time in her beautiful garden, full of flowers, butterflies, and bumblebees.

title: Muna and Milan's Game
author: Anuradha
description: Muna and Milan have returned home after visiting the zoo. They are enjoying pretending to be the animals that they saw there. What animals do you think they visited?

title: Moutushi's Song
author: Maitreyi Shome
description: Moutushi is a little sunbird who loves brightly-coloured flowers. Didima has lots of them growing in her flower pots. Moutushi drinks nectar from the flowers, and in return gives Didima a beautiful gift. What could this gift be?

title: Mother, Call that Bird!
author: Mitralal Pangyani
description: A little child asks her mother to help her adopt a bird.

title: Mike:A Public School Story
author: P. G. Wodehouse
description:
Mike at Wrykyn, introduces Michael "Mike" Jackson. Mike is the youngest son of a renowned cricketing family. Mike's eldest brother Joe is a successful first-class player,
          while another brother, Bob, is on the verge of his school team. When Mike arrives at Wrykyn himself, his cricketing talent and love of adventure bring him success and trouble in equal
          measure.

title: Mermellissa
author: Janaki Sooriyarachchi
description:
Mermellissa is an orphan who is not loved by the family she lives with. Though she always tries to please them, they never even hug her. On her birthday, Mermellissa is feeling very
  sad until she meets a sea monster who gives her a wonderful present - friendship.

title: Meena Series: Take Care Of Girls
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many
          ways, Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she
          laughs, climbs trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. In this story Meena learns that girls and boys have an equal right to
          health care.

title: Meena Series: School First Marriage Later
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many
          ways, Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she
          laughs, climbs trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. This story deals with the prevention of early marriage and retention of
          older girls in school.

title: Meena Series: Say No to Dowry
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many ways,
  Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she laughs, climbs
  trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. In this story, Meena and her family question the practice of dowry.

title: Meena Series: Meena's Three Wishes
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many
          ways, Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she
          laughs, climbs trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. In this story, Meena tackles the issues of hygiene and
          sanitation.

title: Meena Series: Let's Go to School Together
author: Unknown
description:
Meena is a little girl who lives in a village with her parents, her grandmother, her brother Raju and her baby sister, Rani. Mithu, the parrot, is her best friend. In many ways,
  Meena is like any other little girl you know. But in some ways she is completely different. She is friendly but is not afraid to ask questions. Share in Meena’s adventures as she laughs, climbs
  trees, asks questions and solves problems, and shows you all the things that a little girl can do. This story deals with the problem of retaining girls in school (after primary
  level).

title: Masky's Night of Adventure
author: Neehal Khatr
description: After a long day at the beach, Masky just wants a nap. But the wind blows him away on a series of adventures. Will he ever find the perfect place to snooze?

title: Mahagiri - An Elephant Story
author: Hemlata
description:
This simple story of a compassionate elephant is enjoyable in itself but an imaginative teacher can weave many more stories around the context presented in this book. The
  accompanying illustrations can also be put to good use in the classroom. Contributed by: Arvind Gupta

title: Lost in the Internet
author: Madhurima Chakraborty, Kris Stokes
description: Kunal gets lost in the Internet and doesn’t know how to get out. Join him on a sci-fi journey through the Internet as he finds his way home.

title: Look at the animals
author: Jenny Katz
description: Explore the sounds made by different farmyard animals. What noise does the farmer make?

title: London Town
author: Felix Leigh
description: A rhyming picture book that takes you through the famous sights and sounds of London, England.

title: Little House in the Big Woods
author: Laura Ingalls Wilder
keywords: Little House in the Big Woods

title: Listen to My Body
author: Noni
description: Each of us has a wonderful body. But have you ever listened to what it tells you?

title: Lights... Camera... Action!
author: Rupali Bhave
description:
"Watch people move in the magic photographs! A picture two miles long! Only three annas!" This is how a magician named Dadasaheb Phalke invited people in the street to come and watch
  his first film. Other actors in this amazing story about the genius of Dadasaheb Phalke, the Father of Indian Cinema, include a cook who played a woman and the first film editor in Indian cinema
  who happened to be a woman and his wife! If you are a fan of films, you are sure to be fascinated by this script of his life and the making of the first ever Indian film. It has all the ingredients
  of a blockbuster!

title: Life Then - Applies Today
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description:
People in the past were self sufficient. They hand-made objects they needed. Today, we learn to be clever and creative like them. Life then, applies to our high tech world
  today.

title: Let's Have a Water Fight!
author: Anna Farida
description: Alif wants to play with us. However, Alif always makes our games a mess. Is there a game that we can all play together?

title: Kaka and Munni
author: Natasha Sharma
description: Kaka, the wicked crow, wants to eat Munni's eggs. But Munni is a very clever sparrow. And so are all the characters in this popular folktale from Punjab.

title: Jungle Fire: - Flee or Fix
author: Pakaket Alford, Douglas J Alford
description: What do the animals do when a fire threatens their jungle? They can run away or work together to save their homes.

title: Jungle Brew
author: Tanya Luther Agrawal
description:
Bulbuli had heard so much about the mysterious place in the jungle that everybody talked about but nobody had visited. Was she actually going to have the biggest adventure of her
  life with only Totaram for company?

title: Johnny Crow's Garden
author: L. Leslie Brooke
description: Uses the pictures and text of the rhyming picture story by L. Leslie Brooke to tell about a crow and all the animals in his garden.

title: Jimmy's New Glasses
author: Dhruvkaran Nand
description: Jimmy is super excited about his first day at school, but he soon discovers a small problem. Will Jimmy be able to overcome his fear?

title: It's Amma's Birthday Tomorrow
author: Janaki Sooriyarachchi
description: The story of a little girl named Nikini who tries to find the prefect gift for her mother on her birthday. Read the book to find out what she gives her mother.

title: In the Light of the Rising Sun
author: Tara Pun
description: This is a story about a little girl on her very first day of school. On the morning of her first day, she is happy and excited. Will she remember everything she needs to get ready for school?

title: I have to find a Way
author: Jessica Valentina
keywords: I have to Find a Way
description: Keona wants to continue going to school, but her mom can’t afford to send her. Can Keona find a way to earn money to pay for school?

title: I Can Climb!
author: Mini Shrinivasan
description: Here, a little boy learns to climb up. But can he climb down? This book is one of the four books in the 'Growing Up' series.

title: How Freckle Frog Made Herself Pretty
author: Unknown

title: How Far is Far?
author: Sukanya Sinha
description:
If you thought your friend's house on the other side of town was far away, you have clearly not read this book. Climb the Magic Math Ladder to get from where you are to the top of
  Mount Everest, to Kashmir, to the moon, the sun, and ultimately, to the edge of the Universe, which is very, very, VERY far away indeed. Ready, steady, go!

title: Hot Tea and Warm Rugs
author: Mala Kumar, Manisha Chaudhry
description: Meenu's smart winter uniforms are out and the air is filled with the aroma of roasted nuts. Not to forget a cloud of mist in front of her mouth while she speaks! Let us find out what is happening this winter.

title: Here Comes the Camel and Other Poems
author: Prayag Shukla
keywords: Here Comes the Camel and Other Poems
description:
Prayag Shukla's poems in Hindi have enchanted young and old alike. This collection of poems translated into English brings the joy of his writing to a new set of readers. Siraj
  Saxena's innovative artwork adds to the appeal of this classic collection.

title: Half Size Health Workers
author: Unknown
description:
This story has been produced for UNESCO as part of its commitment to the FRESH initiative (Focussing Resources on Effective School Health). The story deal with issues such as
  hygiene, sanitation, disease prevention, violence, discrimination and disaster preparedness. Story telling and story writing can not only confirm knowledge and raise interest but also develop a
  whole range of language and life skills and enhance vital attitudes which children need to develop at school.

title: Garden of Medicines
author: Kedar Shrestha
description: This book describes how the vegetables that grow in our garden keep us fit and healthy. How do green vegetables help us do just that? Read on to find out!

title: Gagan Visits Kamal
author: Shanta Das Manandhar
description: Join Kamal on a journey home through the city. Along the way, he discovers sounds and sights of the city, which are expressed using simple words in this story for early readers.

title: Free Fall
author: David Wiesner
description:
This is a wordless book describing a magical dream adventure of a young boy. As a classic example of fantasy and adventure, the book presents strange locales and unusual characters,
  which keep the action moving and the pages turning. Contributed by: Arvind Gupta

title: Forest Friend
author: Dhruvkaran Nand
description: Tina is a young girl who lives in Purple Cherry village. After a natural disaster, she finds her forest friends in trouble. Will Tina be able to save her friends?

title: Fatima Gregoire and the others
author: Unknown
